label: The Musician
tagline: An engine that hears the gap between the click and the take.
cluster_explainer: Practitioners read the engine for what it does to attention over time, with zero tolerance for popups or nudges.
demo_highlights: Cube reads as a metronomic skeleton — the geometry that does not pretend to be expressive, only accurate
Bass-band reactance couples the engine to the body of the playing, not the surface — what the player feels in the chest
Hold envelope sustains each gesture across its full length, so a phrase reads as one breath rather than one hit
Grid preset is the least decorated of the available styles — the visuals are scaffolding, not a show
No streak counter, no session length, no progress bar in the demo: the playing is not translated into a user metric
